review_basis:
A genuinely fresh real project (VA Renovate/Expand Emergency Room System), pulled from the corpus_2 GitHub Release during a fifth batch-survey pass (also covering 044_NY, 054_NV, 056_NY, 057_US -- none swept this pass; 054_NV's own MH101/MH102 sheets were screened but only offered a single repeated `24"ø EA` label, not pursued). Screened for image coverage first per Run 86's own established check: `imgRatio` reads 0.01 on this sheet, real vector CAD.

Sheet MH102's text scan found 82 already-parseable bare round-duct callouts (`6ø RA`, `12ø SA`, `16ø SA`, etc. -- the `Nø SYS` format with a space before the system suffix, already fully supported, no grammar change needed). A grid sweep of seventeen of them found this real, clean 6.36 LF straight `16ø SA` round duct: `size:{kind:round,d_in:16}`, `systems:["SA"]`, confidence 0.5. A marked crop confirms it visually and unambiguously: a real double-line round duct labeled '16ø SA' directly on the run, from a real reducer/transition splice on one end (down to a `14ø SA` continuation) to a real branch tee on the other (splitting toward a VAV terminal box below and a diagonal `16ø SA` continuation) -- both real, visually-confirmed junction/transition points, matching this corpus's own established ambiguous-stop-at-a-real-junction convention.

Applying this session's own Run 94/95 lesson: verified using the EXACT `bench:linear` seeding convention (`seedOnLongestSegment` -- 40% along the run's only segment, computed by hand) rather than an arbitrary working coordinate. That bench-style seed reproduced the identical trace exactly, and `resolveRunSegments` reproduces the identical single 6.36 LF segment. A reseed `trace_run` from that same bench-style coordinate against the freshly re-loaded, already-committed raw PDF reproduces identical points, length, size, and system.

Other candidates swept on this same sheet but not authored: a `6ø RA` run whose forward stop reads `family_change` (a real, disclosed different-stroke-family transition, e.g. into flex duct or a different construction, not attempted as a golden this pass); an `18ø RA`-labeled seed whose own automatic bind reported the SAME trace and length as the separately-labeled `8ø RA` seed nearby (both landing on the same physical duct segment near a dense multi-branch tee -- a real label-crosstalk instance at a busy junction, disclosed, not authored).
scope: A single real 16-inch round supply-air (SA) duct segment (6.36 LF) on the Emergency Room renovation project's own mechanical plan, sheet MH102, from a real reducer/transition splice (down to a 14-inch continuation) to a real branch tee (splitting toward a VAV terminal box and a diagonal continuation). Explicitly OUT OF SCOPE: the duct's own continuation past either boundary (the 14-inch run, the VAV branch, the diagonal continuation); the `family_change` and label-crosstalk candidates noted in review_basis, neither authored; every other one of the 82 real duct-size callouts found on this same sheet, not attempted this pass; every other sheet on this real 12-sheet plan set.
